files.content:
import type { Address } from "@/features/checkout-address/schemas/address.schema"

/** DummyJSON has no address API, so its users stand in. Point this at your own API. */
export const ADDRESSES_PATH = "/users"

/**
 * Starting data until you connect an API. Province, district, neighbourhood and postal code match
 * the `@virastack/address` dataset; the street lines and phone numbers are made up.
 */
export const DUMMY_ADDRESSES: Address[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    addressName: "Home",
    firstName: "Ömer",
    lastName: "Gülçiçek",
    phone: "5550000000",
    addressLine: "Örnek Caddesi, Deneme Apartmanı",
    provinceCode: "34",
    province: "İSTANBUL",
    district: "KADIKÖY",
    neighbourhood: "CAFERAĞA MAH.",
    postalCode: "34710",
    isDefault: true
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    addressName: "Work",
    firstName: "Ömer",
    lastName: "Gülçiçek",
    phone: "5550000001",
    addressLine: "Örnek Bulvarı, Deneme İş Merkezi",
    provinceCode: "06",
    province: "ANKARA",
    district: "ÇANKAYA",
    neighbourhood: "KIZILAY MAH.",
    postalCode: "06420",
    isDefault: false
  }
]

export const COUNTRY_CODE = "TR"

/** The phone mask, shared by the form and its resolver. */
export const PHONE_MASKS = { phone: { preset: "phone", country: "TR" } } as const

import { z } from "zod"

import * as m from "@/paraglide/messages.js"

// `error` is a function because this schema is built once, before any locale is known.
export const addressFormSchema = z.object({
  addressName: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_title() })
    .max(40, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_too_long() }),
  firstName: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_first_name() })
    .max(50, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_too_long() }),
  lastName: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_last_name() })
    .max(50, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_too_long() }),
  phone: z.string().min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_phone() }),
  addressLine: z
    .string()
    .trim()
    .min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_line() })
    .max(250, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_too_long() }),
  provinceCode: z.string(),
  province: z.string().min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_province() }),
  district: z.string().min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_district() }),
  neighbourhood: z.string().min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_neighbourhood() }),
  postalCode: z.string().min(1, { error: () => m.checkout_address_error_postal_code() }),
  isDefault: z.boolean()
})

export const savedAddressSchema = z.object({ id: z.number() })

export type AddressFormInput = z.infer<typeof addressFormSchema>
export type Address = AddressFormInput & { id: number }
export type AddressType = "shipping" | "billing"

en.checkout_address_same_billing: Use my shipping address for billing
en.checkout_address_dialog_description: Sends a request to the DummyJSON demo API. The address stays only on this page.
en.checkout_address_postal_code_unknown: This postal code was not found.
en.checkout_address_save_error: Could not save the address. Try again.
en.checkout_address_error_phone_invalid: Enter all 10 digits of the phone number

tr.checkout_address_dialog_description: DummyJSON demo API'sine istek atar. Adres yalnızca bu sayfada kalır.
